errors.evidence: The x-axis label in the figure is '因子' (factors), not '碎石值'.
The x-axis shows factor numbers from 1 to 50, with labeled ticks at odd numbers up to 49 and a data point at 50; describing the range as 1 to 49 is incomplete/inaccurate.
The plotted line is black/dark gray, not white.
The markers are open circles, but the description is broadly correct; if interpreted as filled circles, that would be inaccurate. No separate marker error is clearly evident from the image.
The description does not clearly state that this is a scree plot of eigenvalues by factor, only that it is an analysis result of a scree plot.
The description omits the visible open-circle markers and the fact that the line is a single decreasing series with many points across factors 1–50.
